'''Cavamina Minor''' was a small, cold [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] traveled there during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
